projects.name: Project Brief
details: Worked as a business analyst within the Front office trading transformation program supporting the MX.3 platform. Collaborated with Front
office traders, product owners, Risk teams, Market data teams and technology teams to support trade lifecycle management, market data
processing, pricing, valuation, and regulatory reporting initiatives across FX and interest rate products.
Kishore, Page 2 of 2
• Conducted requirement gathering workshops with front office stakeholders, traders, risk managers, and operations teams to understand
business needs and translate them into functional requirements.
• Configured trade lifecycle processes including trade capture, valiation, confirmation, settlement, and reporting.
• Supported Murex MX3 front office initiatives involving FX spot, FX Forward, FX swap, IRS and fixed income products.
• Worked closely with market data teams to analyze and validate FX rates, volatility surfaces, and pricing environments used for trade
valuation.
• Supported Front office operations team during UAT by creating scenarios and executing test cases.
• Supported production releases and post-implementation activities, including incident management and stakeholder communication.

projects.name: Project Brief
details: CITY Bank Deal Manager is a Global Derivative trading platform for Middle office teams which does creating the deals, data mastering for
reference data, Data transformation based on client requirement. Deal Manager has an integrated Operational control framework consumes trade
deals from different Order management systems.
Deal Manageris Integrated Front to back platform that manages different upstream and down stream application to complete investment lifecycle
having Front office, Middle office and Back office management.
• Leading 4 product specialist comprising activities like risk identification, involved in preparing questionnaires, process flow diagrams, &
enterprise analysis to future business cases.
• Solely accountable for planning & day-to-day operations for smooth operations of the technology and business teams.
• Involved in conducting user interviews/requirement workshops to gather requirements and breaking the requirements into EPICS and user
stories, Prioritize stories, release planning, client demos and facilitate UAT and prod migration
• Prioritize the defects, enhancement, and change requests by managing the product backlogs; participate in the UAT phase by conducting
functional testing, tracking issues and bug fixes to ensure smooth client onboarding and data migration, ensure SLAs are met, and develop
opportunities to increase overall client satisfaction levels
• Facilitate as-is analysis of the client current systems, transactional data analysis and interpretation of code and querying the database to ensure there is no lack of available documentation.
